campaign.purpose: One declared idle threshold (PR #366's planned 1.0 SE), all six Tier1 tasks then all21 Tier2 if eligible; complete_current_tier. Seed0, public initializer, original task architecture/data/prior/capacity/sampling/updates/cadence/gates. Separate matched leader control (45000 s; 90000 s total). No tuning grid, scientific retries, seed variants, Tier3, per-task recipes or default adoption. GPU sharing is intentional; costs are not a speed ranking.

hypothesis: Skipping the G/prior step while the critic's paired real-fake gap is within one standard error of zero stops the constant-rate BCAP leader drifting during holds, repairing gaussian1d_stability and mode_hold without losing any control pass.
rationale: Convert gaussian1d_stability and/or mode_hold FAIL to a sustained full-gate PASS while keeping 6/6 Tier1 and every control Tier2 pass, including five_word_joint_hold. Retain every regression and blocked/unmeasured cell.
